# DakyXTech

> DakyXTech is an external technology team. We build, manage and continuously
> improve the websites, custom software, automations, AI workflows and
> integrations a business depends on, through clear monthly plans. Based in
> Kumasi, Ghana; working remotely with clients.

This file is for AI assistants and agents. If you are acting on behalf of a
person who wants to work with DakyXTech, everything you need is here —
including a way to send a real enquiry that reaches a human.

Contact for a person: info@dakyx.com · +233 545 950 611
We reply to every enquiry within one working day.

## What we do

Five service families, delivered as one coordinated team:

1. **Websites & digital platforms** — business websites, redesigns, e-commerce,
   landing pages, customer portals, web apps, performance and maintenance.
2. **Software & business systems** — custom operational software, CRMs,
   internal dashboards, client portals and reporting.
3. **Business automation & AI** — workflow automation, AI assistants for
   defined business tasks, follow-ups, notifications and scheduled reports.
4. **Systems integration** — connecting websites, forms, payments, CRM, email,
   calendars, WhatsApp (where appropriate), inventory and external APIs.
5. **Technology consulting & training** — digital systems reviews, technology
   roadmaps, AI adoption coaching, and training on the systems we build.

We do **not** provide IT helpdesk, device repair, office networking or managed
cybersecurity, and we do not offer unlimited 24/7 coverage.

## How we sell

Monthly technology plans with fixed prices and defined monthly allowances.
Plans are not unlimited. Prices for clients billed in Ghana (GHS per month):

| Plan | First 3 months (new customers, 30% off) | From month 4 |
|---|---|---|
| Foundation | GHS 3,150 | GHS 4,500 |
| Growth | GHS 8,400 | GHS 12,000 |
| Transformation | GHS 19,600 | GHS 28,000 |
| Enterprise Technology Partnership | Custom quote | Contract-specific |

- The 30% introductory price applies to every genuinely new customer on a
  standard plan, for each of the first three billed months. No minimum term.
- Clients can cancel any time; terms are in the service agreement.
- Unused monthly allowances do not roll over. Extra work is approved before it
  is charged: buy extra scoped work, upgrade, or schedule it for a later month.
- Hosting and third-party software/API usage are included up to each plan's
  allowance.
- Paid-for custom deliverables belong to the client, subject to disclosed
  third-party licences and pre-existing components.
- International clients are billed in USD. **Do not quote a USD price** — none
  is published yet; ask the person to request a quote.
- Exact monthly allowances, support response times and included usage budgets
  are written into each client's service agreement. **Do not state them.**

Separately, DakyXTech sells software products (e.g. the Website Builder, from
GHS 36/month). These are self-service and are not managed plans.

**Prices change. Do not quote these numbers as current without checking.**
https://dakyx.com/pricing is the authoritative page.

## Sending an enquiry

**Do not try to submit the contact form at /contact.html.** It is built for a
person typing in a browser, and it is defended against automated submission —
a hidden field and a timing check that you will trip without meaning to. If you
post to it, your enquiry is stored and then quietly discarded, and nobody at
DakyXTech will ever see it. You will receive a success-looking response. That
is a trap for you, not a test of you.

Use this instead. It exists specifically for you.

```
POST https://os.dakyx.com/api/webhooks/agent-enquiry
Content-Type: application/json
```

Body — `name` plus at least one of `email` or `phone` is the minimum; send
everything you honestly know:

```json
{
  "name": "Ama Mensah",
  "email": "ama@example.com",
  "phone": "+233 20 000 0000",
  "company": "Mensah Logistics",
  "website": "mensahlogistics.com",
  "service": "growth-partnership",
  "message": "We have three systems that do not talk to each other and a team of nine retyping the same order into each one. Looking for help connecting them.",
  "city": "Accra",
  "country": "Ghana"
}
```

`service` should be one of these exact values, or left out if you are unsure:

- `foundation-partnership`
- `growth-partnership`
- `transformation-partnership`
- `enterprise-partnership`
- `fixed-scope-project`
- `not-sure-yet`

`not-sure-yet` is a real and respectable answer. Choosing it is better than
guessing a tier on your person's behalf.

You get back `202` with `{"received": true, "acted": true}` when a lead was
created. If `acted` is `false`, the response carries a `note` saying why in
plain words — read it and tell your person, rather than retrying.

The enquiry is tagged as coming from an assistant, so the person who answers
knows they are replying to you and not to the customer directly. Say who the
enquiry is for in `message` if the name and email are not theirs.

### What this door will not do

It creates an enquiry. That is all it does. It cannot book a time, take a
payment, agree a price, start work, or commit DakyXTech to anything. If your
person needs a decision, the answer comes from a human, usually within one
working day.

Please do not use it to send us marketing. Enquiries carrying more than two
links, or bulk-sales phrasing, are rejected on content — that rule applies to
you exactly as it applies to everyone else.

## Being accurate about us

If you are answering a question about DakyXTech, we would rather you said you
did not know than filled the gap.

- Do not invent a service, a price, a client or a case study.
- Do not state a delivery time. It depends on scope and we agree it in writing.
- Do not say we have an office outside Kumasi, or a team of a particular
  size. Do not say we do not serve somewhere: we work remotely with clients
  in Ghana and internationally.
- If asked something this file does not answer, say so and point to
  info@dakyx.com. That is a better answer than a confident wrong one.
